name: interleukin 10

function.text: IL10 encodes interleukin-10. Annotated molecular activities include cytokine activity and growth factor activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.
